        "Owned human test addition: all 635 new test lines and both manifest lines were read. The setup creates NNTP folders plus mock IMAP/EWS hierarchies, waits for root folder counts, sets initial Offline flags, and registers account/tab cleanup after setup. Local Folders and POP3 tasks assert the offline section is hidden and Disk Space remains visible. NNTP, IMAP and EWS tasks distinguish folder/newsgroup buttons, assert initial Offline folder lists, open the subdialog, change checkbox state with mouse and keyboard, accept it, and directly assert the resulting folder lists. This is more than mock configuration or merely executing a path.",
        "Historical NNTP expects first and second offline, then second, third and fourth; IMAP/EWS retain Inbox and second and add third/fourth while first becomes online. Legacy rows include all three remote server roots; range selection plus Space toggles two selected rows. The historical production picker changes flags immediately, records original per-folder values only once, skips server rows, and rolls changed flags back on dialogcancel. Historical account settings opens the picker without a server argument. Accepted code instead passes the current server, omits its root through the shared adapter contract, stages checked folders, and changes Offline flags using added/removed Set differences on dialogaccept. Do not reuse the old all-server row counts or immediate-mutation contract as current behavior.",
        "Accepted setup adds an AutoSync-disabled preference environment, explicit starting flags, and waits for the nested fourth folder in IMAP/EWS as well as root counts. These are later source differences, not changes authored by this entry or fresh test results. Accepted tests use checkbox row/DOM state and Space/Tab actions. They retain the post-dialog flag assertions. The current code comment describes background timer leakage; no leakage or server download was reproduced here.",
